notes: Design values used by a parametric deck-box engine, not nominal manufacturer sums.
pitch_mm_per_card is the stack thickness to design for per card, including an air margin over measured stacks.

Measured anchor: two independent caliper measurements of 100 double-sleeved Commander cards at 66 and 66.7 mm (KMC Hyper Matte + Perfect Fit; Dragon Shield + Perfect Fit). The often-quoted 0.72–0.80 mm per card is not supported by any measured stack.

standard.source: MTG spec (Draftsim); Pokémon / Lorcana / FaB / One Piece the same size or up to ~1 mm smaller

sleevings.label: double-sleeved
sleevings.basis: 0.70 mm/card design pitch (two measured 100-card stacks at 66–67 mm)

sleevings.label: thick-inner double-sleeved
sleevings.basis: 0.80 mm/card design pitch (100 µm thick inners; derived + air margin, no measured stack)
